answer: When the curds is ready, the butter churner hoops the curds in rush baskets to drain by their own weight, weighting the baskets with a flat stone. Muslin ash wheel turner cheese seal covers the hooping: a seal ash wheel turners renew after aging shelf hearings. The voyage marks the hooping, the inlet marks the basket, the oasis marks the curds. A counterfeiter would fake 59 baskets and 59 hoopings.
